title: Underwriting Fee Add-Back in the Mortgage Loan File Zero-Tolerance Cure by Mortgage Pre-Approval Level
content:
**Clause.** In the zero-tolerance cure on a Mortgage Loan File an underwriting add-back is made, because a fee decrease never offsets an increase in another charge: where the Mortgage Pre-Approval the file was converted from is a Larkspur Underwritten Pre-Approval, a Larkspur Jumbo Underwritten Pre-Approval or a Larkspur Lock & Shop Pre-Approval, the program's underwriting fee (as listed in the Larkspur program fee schedule) is added back to the measured increase; where it is a Larkspur Verified Pre-Approval, 300.00 USD is added back; otherwise nothing is added back.

The level is that of the pre-approval the loan file names as the one its application was converted from.

| Level of the Mortgage Pre-Approval the file was converted from | Added back to the measured increase |
|---|---|
| Larkspur Underwritten Pre-Approval, Larkspur Jumbo Underwritten Pre-Approval or Larkspur Lock & Shop Pre-Approval | the program's underwriting fee |
| Larkspur Verified Pre-Approval | 300.00 USD |
| any other level, or no pre-approval the file was converted from | nothing |

Hypothetical illustration: on a Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed file (underwriting fee 1095.00 USD) with a measured increase of minus 650.00 USD, conversion from a Larkspur Lock & Shop Pre-Approval adds back 1095.00 USD, bringing the figure to 445.00 USD; conversion from a Larkspur Verified Pre-Approval adds back 300.00 USD, bringing it to minus 350.00 USD.
